name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Thermal Regulation Bodysuit TRB-3
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Thermal Regulation Bodysuit TRB-3
description: A body-conforming suit that actively regulates the wearer's skin temperature across a range of -40°C to +60°C ambient conditions, maintaining a comfortable microclimate regardless of external environment. The TRB-3 uses a network of thermoelectric elements woven into the fabric that can both heat and cool, redistributing thermal energy from hot areas to cold ones and venting or absorbing excess energy through conductive patches on the suit's exterior. The suit also suppresses the wearer's thermal signature, making them difficult to detect with thermal imaging — a side effect that has made it popular with operators who need both environmental protection and thermal stealth.

specifications.conductive patches: Shoulders and back for thermal exchange

story_hooks: A TRB-3 was worn during a covert entry specifically to defeat thermal surveillance — the building's thermal cameras showed no human heat signature despite a person walking through the frame.

A batch of TRB-3 suits has been manufactured with reversed thermoelectric polarity — instead of protecting the wearer from extreme temperatures, they amplify environmental thermal stress, causing hypothermia in cold conditions and heatstroke in warm ones.

physical_description.visual_profile: Form-fitting undersuit resembling advanced athletic wear with a subtle technological edge. The garment clings to the body's contours like a second skin, with visible mesh paneling and conductive patch networks creating a utilitarian aesthetic.
physical_description.dimensions: Full-body suit; approximately 170-190cm length depending on wearer, fits like compression wear
physical_description.weight_description: Sub-kilogram (0.9 kg total) — barely noticeable when worn, pocketable when compressed
physical_description.primary_material: Synthetic polymer blend with integrated thermoelectric fibers; moisture-wicking base layer with conductive thread weave
physical_description.finish: Matte with subtle iridescent sheen from embedded thermoelectric elements; slight texture from woven fiber pattern
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey primary with silver-white conductive patch accents on shoulders, spine, and upper back; faint blue LED indicators at collar and wrist
physical_description.interface_elements: Small wrist-mounted control pad (6cm×3cm) with minimal tactile buttons; LED status indicators (green: active, amber: battery low, red: malfunction); micro-port at sternum for quick-disconnect thermal core; subtle seams with pressure-sensitive activation points
distinctive_features: Visible conductive patch grid on shoulders and back — bright silver geometric patterns resembling circuit traces
Translucent mesh paneling along ribs and sides revealing the thermoelectric wire network beneath
Micro-perforations across dorsal surface creating a subtle honeycomb texture for thermal venting
Faint blue EL wire threading along the spine and collarbone, glowing when active
Asymmetrical pocket design on left hip for battery pack or backup thermal module
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO HEAVY INDUSTRIES logo embossed on left chest in metallic thread; TRB-3 model designation stamped on sternum port; GLMZ regulatory compliance mark (holographic) on inner right shoulder; Φ pricing label typically affixed to inner tag (removed post-purchase)
physical_description.condition_typical: In use: body-conforming, subtle blue glow at spine and collar, slight thermal shimmer visible around conductive patches in low light; micro-condensation often visible on back/shoulder patches during active cooling mode; at rest: appears as unremarkable grey compression wear
